help.guideSub: Every feature has a section. Start with the five-minute intro.
help.aiSub: How to use AI, what an API is, how to get a key, and how to fix errors.
help.langNote: The manual is currently in Simplified Chinese; the interface can still be switched.
app.name: Corpus Canvas
common.name: Name
home.title: One corpus, many maps.
home.sub: A map is just one way to present your corpus. Nodes link back to the source: change once, update everywhere.
home.costBody: The app is free, with no subscription. For AI you enter your own endpoint and key, and your provider bills you. Without a key or offline, AI entries are visibly greyed out.
home.privacyBody: No account, no telemetry, nothing leaves this computer. You keep the backups; keys never go into backups or logs.
home.networkBody: Only when you start an AI action is the selected text sent to the endpoint you configured. Import, search, backup and drawing all happen locally.
home.recentEmpty: No maps yet. Create one, or build one from your corpus.
home.resumeHint: Your last position is remembered silently and restored next time.
home.offline: No AI key configured. AI entries are greyed out; everything else works.
map.deleteConfirm: Delete the map "{name}"? The cards stay in your corpus.
map.connectHint: Click the source, then the target. Esc cancels.
map.hint: Drag nodes · wheel to zoom · drag canvas to pan · double-click empty space to add
outline.title: Outline
outline.hint: Two-way sync: edit titles or levels here and the map follows immediately.
outline.emptyHint: Add a centre node first, then grow from it.
outline.tabHint: Tab to indent · Shift+Tab to outdent · Enter for sibling
cards.title: Corpus
cards.hint: The source of truth lives here. Every card is free-form, with no fixed fields.
cards.filterPlaceholder: Filter by title, body, note, tag…
cards.emptyHint: Press N to add the first card.
cards.notePlaceholder: An optional note; empty is fine and does not affect the node.
cards.duplicateHint: Similar to the following. Merge only if you decide so.
cards.mergeConfirm: Merge "{a}" into "{b}"? Tags and notes move over; the original goes to trash.
cards.deleteConfirm: Move "{name}" to trash? You can restore it later.
cards.saveHint: Edits are written to the local corpus immediately
search.title: Search
search.placeholder: Search cards, notes and nodes; tolerant of typos and script variants
search.pickTarget: Link these results to which node?
search.structureHint: Find problems by shape: isolated, deepest, duplicates, broken.
search.emptyQuery: Type a keyword, or just use the filters.
search.brokenHint: One end of the link is trashed or deleted.
health.title: Corpus check
health.hint: Cards not in a map, isolated nodes, doubtful links, duplicates and broken links. Hints only; click an item to jump there.
health.unmappedHint: These cards never appear in a map.
health.isolatedHint: Nodes with no links at all.
health.dubiousHint: Links flagged as doubtful; worth a second look.
health.duplicatesHint: Highly similar titles or bodies; consider merging.
history.title: Change history
history.hint: Local edit history. "Roll back" restores the corpus to just before that step.
history.rollbackConfirm: Roll the whole corpus back to before "{name}"? The current state is saved as a restore point first.
history.snapshotRestoreConfirm: Restore "{name}"? The current state is saved as a restore point first.
history.noSnapshots: No restore points yet. They are created automatically before big changes or AI adoption.
trash.title: Trash
trash.hint: Soft-deleted cards wait here until you take them back.
trash.purgeConfirm: Delete "{name}" forever? This cannot be undone.
trash.purgeAllConfirm: Permanently delete all {n} cards in trash? This cannot be undone.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Applies immediately. System uses your computer language, falling back to English.
settings.themeHint: Affects the interface only, never your corpus.
settings.aiHint: Bring your own key. Works with common OpenAI-style endpoints, or a local model.
settings.apiKeyPlaceholder: Paste your key; stored locally only
settings.apiKeySaved: Key is stored locally and is never included in backups.
settings.localModelHint: No key; talk directly to a local compatible server such as Ollama or LM Studio.
settings.costBody: This app is free: no subscription, no in-app purchase. AI usage is billed by your provider, not by us.
settings.privacyBody: No account, no telemetry, no cloud sync. Corpus and keys stay on this machine.
settings.networkAi: AI draft / organize / summarize / review: sends the selected text to your endpoint.
settings.networkOff: Everything else — import, drawing, search, backup, restore — runs locally.
settings.networkKey: Keys are used in request headers only; never written to backups or logs.
settings.formatBody: Data is stored as readable JSON, format version v{version}. Even if the app stops being maintained, you can always open it with any text tool.
settings.importAsk: Backup holds {cards} cards and {maps} maps. How should it be imported?
settings.aboutBody: Corpus Canvas · a general mind-mapping tool. No reminders, no notifications, no background daemon, no autostart.
settings.clearAllConfirm: This deletes every card and map on this machine and cannot be undone. Continue?
settings.keysLocal: Keys never enter backups or logs and can be cleared in one click.
settings.noTelemetry: No account · no telemetry · no subscription
ai.title: AI assist
ai.draftHint: Paste notes or a document to get a map draft. Nodes and links stay drafts until you confirm them one by one.
ai.organizeHint: Group, merge, rename, restructure. Scope defaults to the selected nodes only.
ai.summarizeHint: Summarize nodes, notes or a long document; the summary appears as a draft first.
ai.reviewHint: Annotates only, never edits. Each item states location, problem, suggestion and confidence.
ai.inputPlaceholder: Paste notes, a document or bullet points…
ai.scopeHint: By default only selected nodes or branches are sent; the whole corpus is never sent.
ai.failedHint: No silent retry. Check endpoint, key, model name or quota.
ai.keyMissingHint: Add endpoint, model and key in settings, or use a local model.
ai.parseError: The response could not be parsed into a draft. It is kept verbatim; copy it manually if useful.
ai.acceptConfirm: Accepting writes the draft into the corpus.
import.title: Import file
import.hint: XMind, OPML and Markdown outlines are converted into the same corpus; no separate map files are kept.
import.already: Provenance was recorded so imports stay traceable.
import.dropHint: You can also drop a file onto the window.
shortcut.title: Keyboard shortcuts
map.boundaryHint: Select the nodes to frame first
style.title: Style
demo.name: Sample corpus
map.marqueeTitle: Box select: drag on empty canvas to pick several nodes
theme.title: Theme library
present.empty: There is nothing to present in this map
print.title: Print
ai.streamHint: Text appears as it is generated. Press “Cancel request” to stop at any time.
